_ytflow_note: SHOT RECOMPOSE — Epic 10 '확정 방향'. The composited still is NOT the output: it is the STRUCTURE SOURCE. The frame is re-generated so background and characters are drawn as one image, with nothing pasted. Structure (plate composition + where each character stands) is held by ControlNet on the still; character identity is held by IPAdapter on the card. This is the opposite of the rejected masked-img2img route, where the card's own pixels survived into the output — see the epic's '얹어놓기 vs 재창조' table. Judgement rule: if the output's card region is nearly identical to the source card, it is stitching, not recomposition. Wiring mirrors comfyui_location_plate_api.json, which already runs ControlNet+IPAdapter in production for plate seeding; only the inputs differ (structure ref -> composite still, style anchor -> character card). Background must NOT be re-invented: plates are a reused fixed source set by policy, so ControlNet strength stays high and the background has to survive. Injection points: '1' still, '20' card, '3'.denoise/'3'.seed, '32'.strength. Marker stays false until a live probe passes.

_meta.title: Composite still — plate + cards, motion off. STRUCTURE ONLY; its pixels are not the answer.
Character card — the identity reference. Fed to IPAdapter, never composited.
Same checkpoint the plates were generated with

Identity conditioning, SCOPED. Without attn_mask IPAdapter drives the WHOLE frame's palette: measured on S00403, colour cast vs the IPAdapter-off control was 7.4 (off) -> 22.3 (style 0.60) -> 33.3 (linear 0.85). The card is dark navy, so the room went blue. This mask limits WHERE the conditioning applies; it does NOT protect card pixels — the card is still fully re-drawn, which is what separates this from the rejected masked-img2img route.
SDXL union (canny/depth/pose in one). The SD1.5 controlnets in this folder cannot patch an SDXL checkpoint.
Union needs its conditioning type declared — the literal must be one of the server COMBO options ("canny" alone is rejected)
Edges of the WHOLE still — the plate's architecture and each character's silhouette in place. This is what stops the recompose from moving anything.
High strength and full duration: the background is a reused fixed source by policy and must survive the regeneration.
Positive — the shot's own image_prompt is injected here, so per-shot intent is not discarded

_meta.title: The still anchors colour and value; ControlNet anchors structure. denoise decides how much is re-drawn on top of that.
denoise injected per probe. High is the point: the card's pixels must NOT survive.
Card coverage mask — white where a character stands. Measured by rendering the card chain over black and over white (video.render_card_coverage_mask), never re-derived from placement arithmetic.
Dilate so identity conditioning reaches slightly past the silhouette and the contact edge is drawn as part of the figure, not the room.
